scope: Three additive documentary files only. Preserve all existing tracked files and the full private audit-local tree. No participant-value parsing or inspection, contacts or inferred approvals.
negative_control_method: In-memory clones of the parsed acceptance JSON had each of 21 held authority flags flipped to true, then formal rights approval, institutional adoption, reviewer assignment or disposition invented individually. The held-state validator rejected all 25 mutations; no fixture files were created.
review_method: Same-agent exact source-to-snapshot string comparison, JSON parsing, byte/SHA-256 verification, explicit content/status checks, in-memory negative controls and repository preservation checks. Not independent human/institutional review or a legal determination.
snapshot_provenance: Complete substantive immediately preceding R10 chat account retained, with historical pending-acceptance question and no-change statement explicitly framed as earlier-turn wording. No platform-authenticated export or message identifier available.

preservation.method: Two complete scans: existing absolute paths sorted case-sensitively; SHA-256 of UTF-8 concatenation absolute_path TAB byte_length TAB uppercase_file_SHA256 LF. Extended Windows paths used for access. Count, byte total and digest match in both groups.
preservation.scope_limit: Local tracked files and existing private audit-local files only. Opaque hashing did not parse participant values; no participant records, remote permissions, cloud copies, data-bearing Git revisions or third-party copies inspected. New records are outside the preservation groups and separately hashed; this audit does not self-hash.

proposed_commit.title: docs: record documentary acceptance of R10 delegation and grant account
description: Preserve the full consolidated R10 account and record the author's exact documentary acceptance dated 25 October 2026.

Record author-reported exclusive ownership, delegated reuse/licensing authority and delegated manuscript submission decisions without a separate Fundacion Capital sign-off; do not authenticate the underlying instruments or infer coauthor assent.
Preserve the CFI pre-submission approval checkpoint, distinguish it from grant review/comment provisions and retain the original grant obligations as the documentary starting point.
Keep publication order, CFI review recipient/timing, executed-agreement completeness, rights compatibility and material-specific permissions unresolved.
Distinguish no known amendments or additional restrictions from independently verified absence; retain restricted-data scope and the user's scientific decision authority.
Validate 38 content/status checks and 25 negative controls, including exact accepted-text comparison and rejection of invented rights/approvals.
Verify unchanged preservation fingerprints for all 1,264 existing tracked files and 23,281 private audit files.
No participant inspection, contacts, fitting, analysis/manuscript changes, licence application, cleanup, commit, push, synchronization, submission or release.

completion_boundary: Completion is documentary acceptance recording and its audit only. R10 formal response remains pending. No legal effect, ownership/delegation authentication, CFI manuscript approval, agreed publication sequence or permission to submit/release established. R11 not initiated.
